items.name: Readability
items.evidence: This is a two-line change. It includes the short comment '# Ensure base table is in aliases.' and the formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper and leaves no dead code or debug leftovers. The temporary test file was removed, and the change is identical to the reference fix.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The change is minimal and idempotent. get_initial_alias() returns the existing alias if one is already set. It swallows no errors, adds no magic constants and opens no resources. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in single_alias, which now registers the base alias before counting. Joined deletes still count more than one alias and keep the subquery, and the MySQL override benefits too. The agent checked that a filtered delete still produces 'DELETE ... WHERE "desc" = %s'.
